Haplotype-resolved de novo assembly using phased assembly graphs with hifiasm
Cheng, Concepcion, Feng, Zhang, Li. Nature Methods 2021.

PacBio HiFi reads were assembled with hifiasm to produce haplotype-resolved contig assemblies.
When Hi-C data were available, hifiasm was run in Hi-C mode to phase haplotypes.
Contig assemblies were evaluated for completeness.
Contig N50 and BUSCO completeness were recorded for the haplotype-resolved assemblies.
